what: [order-path] 'orphaned' is treated as a TERMINAL trade status (order_monitor._TERMINAL_TRADE_STATUSES, mirrored by strategy_monocle._TERMINAL_LEG_STATUSES in #14590) although an orphaned leg may still hold a position at the broker. Consequences: (1) the open-package gate stops counting that account as holding the leg, so a new package can be dispatched onto an account that still carries the old position (stacking); (2) _sweep_stuck_linked_packages can close the package while the broker position is alive. Not measured yet: how many 'orphaned' trades had a live broker position at the time they were marked.
why_it_matters: The anti-stacking gate's correctness depends on 'terminal' meaning 'no position at the venue'; orphaned breaks that assumption silently.
